# Privacy Baseline

A minimum bar for handling personal data. Legal and regulatory requirements specific to the project take precedence and belong in docs/engineering/PROJECT.md.

## Principles

- Data minimization: collect and keep only the personal data needed for a stated purpose.
- Purpose limitation: do not reuse personal data for a new purpose without review.
- Retention: every store of personal data has a defined retention period and a deletion path.

## In code and systems

- Identify fields that hold personal data in schemas and data models.
- Never log personal data in plain text. Redact or tokenize identifiers in logs, traces, and error reports.
- Use synthetic or anonymized data in tests, fixtures, examples, and demos. Never copy production data into development environments.
- Encrypt personal data in transit and at rest.
- Restrict access to personal data to the services and roles that need it.

## Third parties

- Sending personal data to an external service (including hosted model APIs, analytics, and error trackers) requires an explicit, documented decision.
- Prefer sending the minimum fields necessary, redacted where possible.

## Escalate

- Flag for human review any change that adds a new category of personal data, a new external data recipient, or a new retention period.
